title: Teach bwrk next the verified and needs_verification limbo states
description: WHY: bwrk next currently returns state idle for this workspace while bw_work_caa619f2ed9b24e7 sits in verified (one work close away from terminal) and bw_work_cd28d24ebd9a785b sits in needs_verification (one work verify away). The next-loop state machine (nextCommand handling in apps/cli/src/commands.ts around lines 7640-7700) checks active reservations, expired reservations, ready work and sync health - but not the two statuses that represent someone finished the work and nobody completed the paperwork. These limbo items age silently, which is precisely the accountability leak the tracker exists to prevent. WHAT: add next-loop branches - when the workspace has needs_verification items, emit a directive to verify the oldest (command bwrk work verify <id> --evidence <listed>) and when it has verified items, emit a directive to close (bwrk work close <id> --reason ...), respecting reservation ownership where a reservation exists and otherwise addressing any agent. Order these after active-reservation continuation but before the claim-ready branch, since finishing near-terminal work beats starting new work. Add fixture tests for both states and update the termination property fixtures so the loop drives limbo items to terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk next --json on a workspace with only a needs_verification item returns a verify directive naming that item
bwrk next --json on a workspace with only a verified item returns a close directive naming that item
Termination property fixtures cover both limbo states and pass
closedReason: bwrk next now handles verified and needs_verification limbo states
